body.name: Leave-one-cell-out direct IPW multiplier process
body.construction: For every cell \( (i,j)\), replace only \(Z^{\mathrm{ipw}}_{ij}\) by zero, compute \(\widehat M^{(-ij)}=\mathcal P_r(Z^{\mathrm{ipw}}-Z^{\mathrm{ipw}}_{ij}e_ie_j^\top)\), and set \(\widehat e_{ij}=Z^{\mathrm{ipw}}_{ij}-\widehat M^{(-ij)}_{ij}\). For every \(g\in\mathcal G_n\), set \(\widehat\tau_g=\sum_{i,j}g_{ij}Z^{\mathrm{ipw}}_{ij}\) and \(\widehat s_g^2=\sum_{i,j}g_{ij}^2\widehat e_{ij}^2\). Draw conditionally independent \(\xi_{ij}\sim N(0,1)\), and define \(c_{1-\alpha}\) as the conditional \(1-\alpha\) quantile of \(\max_{g\in\mathcal G_n}|\sum_{i,j}\xi_{ij}g_{ij}\widehat e_{ij}/\widehat s_g|\).
inputs: The IPW score, rank, and deterministic contrast family.
